name: City of Belleville
summary: 15.6% police budget spike; procurement transparency failures; integrity commissioner complaints

findings.title: Police budget — 15.6% one-year spike
findings.detail: Belleville Police Service budget increased 15.6% in a single year with no corresponding public safety metric improvement

findings.title: Integrity commissioner complaints
findings.detail: Multiple integrity commissioner complaints filed against council members; findings partially withheld from public

findings.title: Procurement transparency gaps
findings.detail: Sole-source contracts above threshold approved without required council ratification in 2022-2023 period
